title: Roasted Sterbottensost with Moroccan Spices
description: A French-inspired recipe that combines the flavors of roasted Sterbottensost cheese with traditional Moroccan spices.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice blend
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and ginger

instructions: Cut the Sterbottensost cheese into wedges.
Place the cheese on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cheese and sprinkle with Moroccan spice blend.
Season with coarse black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and slightly browned.
Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
